title: Beyond Semantic Accuracy: Consequence-Aware Evaluation for Safety-Critical Language Understanding
desc: Tests whether semantic scores misstate operational reliability in air traffic control. Across eight models, conventional metrics overstate reliability; risk-aware fine-tuning narrows but does not close the gap.

title: Safety-Oriented Evaluation of Language Understanding Systems for Air Traffic Control
desc: Studies the problem of evaluating language understanding systems in safety-critical ATC environments and proposes a risk-aware, consequence-oriented evaluation framework.

title: VMLU Benchmarks: A Comprehensive Benchmark Toolkit for Vietnamese LLMs
desc: Four datasets assessing the general knowledge, reading comprehension, reasoning and conversational skills of Vietnamese LLMs. Evaluates Llama-3, Qwen2.5, GPT-4 and more.

title: KiLM — Vision Language Model
desc: Vision language models for image captioning, OCR, and visual question answering powering Zalo's image retrieval features. Achieved 43.8% on Vi-MTVQA — highest at time of release.

title: KiLM
desc: One of the first Vietnamese LLMs pre-trained from scratch on nearly 7 TB of cleaned text. Achieved SOTA on TencentLMEval and VMLU, surpassing GPT-4 with 66.07 on VMLU.

title: VinaLLaMA: LLaMA-based Vietnamese Foundation Model
desc: An early open-weight Vietnamese LLM that adds 800B pre-training tokens to LLaMA-2. Its chat model, tuned on 1M synthetic samples, was state of the art at release.

title: Vietcuna
desc: First instruction-tuned BLOOMZ-based model for Vietnamese, achieving thousands of monthly downloads and fostering the local open-source AI community.

title: ViDeBERTa: A Powerful Pre-trained Language Model for Vietnamese
desc: A Vietnamese encoder that surpassed the previous state of the art on several NLU tasks, with a base model under a quarter the size of PhoBERT-large.

title: A study of R-Drop in BARTpho for Vietnamese Abstractive Text Summarization
desc: Enhanced BARTpho performance for Vietnamese text summarization using R-Drop regularization.
